divergences.upstreamResult: React flexRender recognizes class components and memo/forwardRef exotic component objects.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane components, including memo-wrapped components, are plain functions and flexRender uses the function branch.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no React class-component or exotic-object component model.
divergences.consumerImpact: Octane component functions render with equivalent props; React exotic objects cannot be passed directly.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Author the cell or header as an Octane function component and use Octane memo when needed.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces non-function component descriptors.

divergences.upstreamResult: React Table publishes a ./legacy migration subpath with useLegacyTable and v8 compatibility types.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane binding omits the React-v8 migration-only subpath.
divergences.rationale: There is no prior Octane React Table v8 consumer surface to migrate.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers cannot import the legacy v8 compatibility API.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use the v9 useTable API directly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if an Octane v8 compatibility requirement emerges.
